name: Guangdong Syntrust GK Testing and Certification Tech Service Center Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Syntrust GK Testing and Certification Tech Service Center, based in Xinyi since 2000, performs construction engineering testing and inspection in China, covering foundations, structures, materials, roads, water transport, environment and housing appraisal. It also offers food and agricultural testing, fire protection and safety assessment to developers, state-owned investors and government bodies. It was formerly named Xinyi Xince.
